opportunities.point: Gross revenue is projected to cross 500 crores in FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "guidance for FY26 as it crosses X500 crores in gross revenues to step up over 30% from what we delivered in FY26." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company installed a state-of-the-art 6-ton hammer to enhance forging capabilities.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "We installed another state-of-the-art 6-ton hammer to significantly enhance our forging capabilities." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Indian Railways issued a production plan for approximately 6,000 passenger coaches and 1,200 to 1,400 locomotives.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "this year's production, for the passenger coaches, around 6,000 numbers, locomotives around 1,200 to 1,400 locomotives, which is the same as last year, and a big wagon tender is coming up, by Railways board." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company entered the year with an order book exceeding 300 crores.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "We enter FY26 with an order book of X300 crores which gives us good revenue visibility over" (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Current plant capacity utilization across all plants is approximately 70%.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "We are already working on, approximately 70% of our capacity, and we keep on increasing the bottleneck, where the capacity extension is required. So, we are working around 70% of our capacities, in all the plants." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Management committed to remaining fully committed to the targets set for Financial Year 2027.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "We look forward to updating you next quarter and we remain fully committed to the targets we have set for the Financial Year 2027." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01) [FY27]

opportunities.point: EBITDA margin improved to 26.80% in Financial Year 26 from 21.47% in Financial Year 25.
opportunities.evidence: Margins / costs: "Our EBITDA margin improved to 26.80% in Financial Year 26 from 21.47% in Financial Year ‘25." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: A premium multiple versus peers can unwind quickly if growth slips.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Firm steel prices in FY27 could lead to some moderation in margins in the near term.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Though if steel prices remain firm in FY27, there may be some moderation in margins in the near term." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)
